hero.name: Kaushal Kumar
hero.title: DevOps Enthusiast | CI/CD | Kubernetes | AWS
hero.subtitle: DevOps Enthusiast
hero.description: Crafting fully automated pipelines, robust container orchestration environments, and highly reliable AWS architectures to maximize uptime and minimize delivery bottlenecks.

about.bio: DevOps enthusiast with hands-on experience in building CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration using Kubernetes, and provisioning scalable AWS infrastructure with Terraform. Proven ability to reduce deployment time by 80% and improve system reliability through automation and cloud-native practices.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Engineering

experience.description: Customer Care Executive (CCE) at Cyfuture India Pvt. Ltd., focused on effective communication, handling customer queries, and delivering prompt support. Strengthened interpersonal skills, active listening, and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.

Assisted in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines to automate build and deployment processes. Worked with Git, Docker, and Linux-based environments for application deployment and version control. Supported server configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting to ensure system reliability. Collaborated with development team to optimize deployment workflows and reduce manual errors. Contributed to infrastructure documentation and environment setup for scalable application management.

Completed virtual internship in Cloud Computing via IBM Skills Network. Learned cloud deployment models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and infrastructure basics. Gained exposure to AWS services and cloud architecture fundamentals.

Supported Linux, Cloud, and DevOps training operations. Troubleshot technical issues and assisted learners. Worked with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and Linux systems. Contributed to deployment and cloud setup tasks.

Built an Agentic AI platform using LLMs for task automation and decision-making. Worked with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and cloud-based workflows. Implemented CI/CD, containerization, and automation practices. Developed applications using Python and REST APIs.
Understood security practices in cloud and deployment environments. Focused deeply on computer network protocols and vulnerability scanning.

projects.title: End-to-End CI/CD Pipeline Deployment
projects.description: Designed and implemented a fully automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker, enabling seamless build, test, and deployment workflows. Deployed static applications on AWS S3 with CloudFront integration, achieving automatic sync on every commit and reducing deployment time from hours to seconds.
details: Designed and implemented a fully automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker, enabling seamless build, test, and deployment workflows.
Deployed static applications on AWS S3 with CloudFront integration, achieving automatic sync on every commit and reducing deployment time from hours to seconds.
Achieved 90% deployment reliability through parallel job execution and failure handling strategies.

projects.title: E-Commerce Website For - Floveera Private Limited
projects.description: Containerized and deployed a microservices-based e-commerce application using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable orchestration. Configured NGINX as a reverse proxy, built automation pipelines, and implemented load balancing and auto-scaling.
details: Containerized and deployed a microservices-based e-commerce application using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable orchestration.
Built an automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for seamless build and deployment to K8s clusters.
Configured NGINX as a reverse proxy and implemented load balancing and auto-scaling to ensure high availability.
